notes.title: Update 1.13: New Levels, Editor Additions
notes.content:
Thanks for playing circloO!

This update contains [b]four new levels[/b]! In addition, there are the following [b]improvements for the level editor[/b]:
[list]
[*] You can now choose a sound effect for collectables. There's a limited selection right now, but it might be expanded in the future. You can also change the volume and pitch.
[*] Add a "Generate Only Once" button to generators
[*] There are new options for special collectables: 
[list]
[*] Disable/enable rotation (for moveable blocks/triangles)
[*] "Generate One if None Exists" and "Destroy spawned objects" options for generators
[*] Enable/disable teleporters or collectables
[/list][*] Add a button to easily change the type of a collectable
[*] The Load menu has been improved
[*] Undoing is now possible after playtesting a level
[/list]
I hope you'll enjoy this update!

notes.title: Update 1.12: New Levels, Small Improvements
notes.content:
Thank you for playing circloO! This update contains the following:
[list]
[*] Four extra levels in the first level pack, as well as some minor level changes, to smoothen the difficulty curve a bit
[*] The first page of the Featured tab may now show some older featured levels, if you already completed some of the current ones
[*] If you get a time on a leaderboard, that will now be displayed directly in the Player-Created Levels menu as well
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.11: Leaderboards, Editor Multi-Select, Moveable Portals, and More!
notes.content:
Thanks for playing circloO! This update adds the following new features for the level editor and custom levels:
[list]
[*] There's box select and you can move/duplicate/destroy all selected items
[*] There are two new special connection targets, to use portals and to disconnect ropes+hinges. For generators, there are extra special connection options to spawn one object now or to Enable & Reset the timer.
[*] For levels made with this new version, some object types are rendered in a different way to hopefully get better consistency between pc and mobile, as well as prevent some misalignment issues
[*] Levels have a leaderboard and average playtime. They can also have a description and walkthrough link.
[*] You can connect a rope to a portal to make that portal move relative to the object on the other side of the rope
[*] Some QOL changes in the editor
[*] Adds "Starred by You" and "Completed by You" in the Playlists (+ Started by You all the way in the back just in case anyone needs it)
[*] Adds a Duration filter to the search
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.10: Music, Bigger Levels, Special Collectable
notes.content:
Hi! Thank you for playing circloO! This update adds two new tracks of music and the following tools for level makers in the editor:
[list]
[*] The new special collectable allows you to disable generators or follow a moveable circle of your choice
[*] You can choose your preferred music for your level. More options might become available later here
[*] You can choose to disable sound effects for collectables in your level. Options for different sound effects might become available later
[*] Your level can now be up to 10 parts big
[*] Since recently, the Fresh tab has been rearranged and will have a better variety of levels
[*] You can now Ctrl+Click to select multiple elements and move them around that way. This is hopefully the start of also allowing box-select for this, as well as allow duplicating multiple elements, in the future.
[*] And, of course, some bugfixes
[/list]
Enjoy!

notes.title: Update 1.9: Bezier Curves, Box Generators, New Levels and More!
notes.content:
Thank you very much for playing circloO! There are now over 10,000 player created levels for circloO! That calls for a new update.

Watch the update video:
[previewyoutube=79TeOQV7DXI;full][/previewyoutube]

Or see the release notes below:
- 6 new levels
- New Playlists tab in the level browser
- Bezier curves
- The Box Generator
- Growing rectangles
- Connections work with more object types (e.g. pulleys work with collectibles)
- Player Speed Change Collectibles
- You can duplicate arcs
- Better performance for some levels (e.g. Random Adv.)
- And more!

I hope you'll enjoy this update!

notes.title: Minor Update: More Custom Level Stats & More
notes.content:
Thank you very much for playing circloO! This update contains the following:

[list]
[*] Add some featured playlists to the player created levels, to help you find fun levels to play more easily
[*] You can now disable early-game tuturial hints
[*] You can now see the total number of players and completions in the pause/end menu of a custom level
[*] Makes it possible to export levels to a file or the clipboard from the editor, and of course import them again as well
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Update: Level Search Improvements & More
notes.content:
Thank you for playing circloO! This update contains the following:
- There are now some sorting & filtering options when searching for player levels. Additionally, if you're looking for a challenge you can try filter:hard - I don't have a lot of data for this yet so it's not an "official" option.
- In the Editor, you can now click multiple times to select objects underneath other objects
- In the Editor, most objects are now selected automatically after you placed them so you can change settings easily
- Some early levels have extra hints in places where people often got stuck

notes.title: New Levels and More Level Editor Improvements!
notes.content:
A new update for circloO is now live, containing both new levels and a lot of Level Editor improvements. It's also easier to discover playermade levels with a new category in the level browser.

It contains the following:
- 6 brand-new levels in the Extra Levels pack. There are now 62 total official levels, plus almost 2000 player created levels!
- To improve the difficulty curve, I made circloO 2 level 3 and 4 easier. Also, Extra Level 2 is moved further into the level pack. I apologize for any problems these changes cause with speedrunning, but I feel like they really improve the game for new players.
- A Discover category in the Player-Created levels screen, which showcases 10 levels every day. This replaces the rather stagnant Stars category. To sort by stars, please search sort:best for now.
- Levels load a bit faster
For the level editor:
- Collectibles now have a Trigger option, which allows them to be reused
- They also have a Camera Zoom setting, so you can zoom in or out or even show the whole level at once
- The collectable that disconnects player connections now has an "on collision" variant
- There's a new Prismatic/Slider connection
- A level can now start at full size
- Attractors can now push. For this, set the Attractor property to a negative value
- You can now set coordinates of triangles and arcs
- Arcs and Lines can now have custom thickness
- The Hinge connection can now have a motor
- You can now delete saves (in the Save menu)
- By default, for new levels, the player will now use more precise physics, which makes it less often pass through small moving objects. You can disable this in the Start properties
- Various bugfixes

Enjoy the update!

notes.title: Level Editor Improvements
notes.content:
Over 1000 levels have already been uploaded from the circloO level editor! It's been awesome to see all that creativity. This update adds even more options to the editor, and makes it easier to find your way among all the levels in the level browser.

This update:
- Adds the superglue connection for moveables. This is a very strong connection that is great for making a large complex moveable shape.
- Adds the hinge connection. This is great for creating hinges or wheels.
- Adds a collectable that breaks all connections to the player.
- Makes it easier to create arcs whererever you want them with the new through-three-points creation option.
- Allows you to exactly position most basic shapes by using the new coordinates option
- Adds a search function to the level browser
- Adds a Fresh category to the level browser, with the highest rated levels in the last week
- Makes it possible to see levels you uploaded in the level browser
- And more!

Enjoy!

notes.content:
